name: AXM Challenge Arena
actions: lock one challenge for multiple independent seats
preserve immutable candidate and review revisions
run deterministic evidence checks with candidate execution disabled by default
assign evidence-grounded blind reviews without self-voting
surface recommendations, dissent, evidence gaps, lineage, and proposed-only merge maps
export and verify reproducible evidence bundles
summary: A Mike-directed, local-first challenge platform for independent attempts, deterministic evidence, assigned blind review, dissent-preserving synthesis, and explicit human decisions.
notes: TEST intake of sealed upstream v0.6.0 source. The Hub page is an inert front door; the Python runtime writes only when explicitly invoked. Candidate execution is off by default and --allow-execution is not a security sandbox. No result, vote, recommendation, or merge map can install, promote, merge, or become CANON automatically.
